name: Sanctuary of Heracles (Eleia)
text: Ruin seen by Pausanias near the tomb of Saurus west of the Erymanthus river.

depictions.name: Sanctuary of Hera
depictions.text: The Sanctuary of Hera was a temple in Hera's Watch in Argolis, Greece. It was part of the sanctuary Heraion of Argos and dedicated to the Greek goddess Hera. It was protected by military personnel.
